caption: Each arrow is an algorithm that keeps the language unchanged, so all three boxes describe the same languages; follow the loop in either direction to convert.

spec.title: Kleene's theorem: one loop, three conversions
spec.aria: A cycle of three equivalent views — regular expression to epsilon-NFA by Thompson's construction, epsilon-NFA to DFA by subset construction, and DFA back to regular expression by Arden's theorem or state elimination.
